summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (ipns-signature-verify-coverage) of the CipherBox project — a backend crypto/security phase adding IPNS signature verification coverage across Rust and TypeScript/JS layers.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 was fully planned (4 plans, 2 waves, RESEARCH.md + VALIDATION.md + PATTERNS.md committed), Wave 1 Plan 58-01 completed after a crash-recovery continuation, and Wave 1 Plan 58-02 was dispatched but the transcript ends mid-execution.

repo: Phase 58 uses TDD mode with fine granularity, 4 plans in 2 waves, keyed to HARD-09 requirement and decisions D-01..D-13.

The `crates/crypto` crate cannot dev-depend on `api-client/core`, so cross-language test vectors must live in `crates/fuse/tests/` instead — a real dependency-cycle constraint surfaced by the planner.
The full local dev stack (redis:6380, api:3000, postgres, ipfs/kubo) was up during execution, which enabled 58-02's full-SDK-E2E gate to run automatically.
ROADMAP.md wave annotations were already idempotent (already present) when the orchestrator attempted to write them.
AUTO_MODE=true and AUTO_CHAIN=true were both active for this session.
The `gsd-tools commit` helper returns `commit_failed` as a false negative — actual success must be confirmed via `git log`.
58-02 (non-CAS embedded-sequence tightening) was flagged as highest-risk: a prior tightening in this class broke 48/89 SDK E2E tests.

code.finding: New file added in 58-01: `resolve_ipns_verified` wrapper that routes 9 FUSE resolve sites through CBOR cid/sequence binding verification chokepoint.
ciborium dependency added here — a mid-execution diagnostic falsely reported it missing, but it was present and the compile was clean.

workflow: Sequential execution on the feature branch was chosen over parallel worktree execution for this security-sensitive phase — project history shows parallel worktrees cause cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees.
Subagent socket drops mid-task leave uncommitted diff on disk; recovery requires inspecting `git status` + `git diff` before spawning a continuation to avoid duplicate or conflicting work.

The plan checker's single warning (RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` missing `(RESOLVED)` marker) was fixed inline rather than burning a full planner revision cycle — correct judgment for a cosmetic issue.
VALIDATION.md frontmatter is written by the orchestrator; body scaffold is owned by execute/validate tooling — they have separate ownership.
The `--chain` flag causes auto-advance from plan-phase directly into execute-phase without user confirmation.

friction: Subagent API socket error dropped the 58-01 executor mid-task-3, requiring manual state assessment and a continuation spawn.
The `gsd-tools commit` false-negative (`commit_failed` on success) requires a redundant `git log` verification step after every commit.
RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` heading lacked a `(RESOLVED)` marker, triggering a plan-checker warning that required a direct file edit to clear.
open_items: 58-02 execution was in-flight at transcript end — outcome (pass/fail on D-09/D-10 non-CAS embedded-sequence gate and full-SDK-E2E) unknown.
Wave 2 plans (58-03: web/sdk-core resolve dedup; 58-04: shared cross-language verify vectors) not yet started.
Cargo.lock modification was pre-existing and untouched throughout — may need attention before merging `feat/ipns-signature-verify-coverage`.
Desktop E2E .mjs helpers (per existing memory) bypass tsc/eslint — any new verify logic added via these helpers in this phase would have the same blind spot.
